a.lede: The CEOs of OpenAI and Anthropic, as well as other industry leaders, are calling for a general slowdown in AI development over safety fears. On the flip side, Chinese authorities, the U.S. President, and CEO of Nvidia have dismissed their concerns as fearmongering.
a.title: AI leaders clash over safety fears after Anthropic whistleblower says AI could 'kill us all' by 2030 — OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI figureheads call for external governance, while Jensen Huang says worries are 'made up'

b.lede: Mustafa Suleyman says he believes rival AI firm Anthropic is in effect teaching Claude it "may be conscious".
b.title: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, warns Microsoft
